inventory.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.

net_income.missing_policy: None when parent-attributable profit is absent.

related_party_funds.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.

restricted_cash.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Unmapped: require reviewed restricted monetary funds, not total restricted assets. Missing blocks usable cash and dependent debt/net-cash metrics; independent FCF yield can remain available. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.

revenue.missing_policy: None when the reported consolidated line is absent.

shares.missing_policy: None unless the exact field is finite and positive; no total-share alias is accepted.

total_equity_including_minority.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Gross IC requires this minority-inclusive equity plus verified interest debt; never substitute parent-attributable equity. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.
